args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Combined Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/cold-chain/companion):

• Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
• Most savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece: pilots cut claims by a quarter (25%).
